title: 80s action, straight to video
blurb: Ninjas, Cannon Films at full tilt, and a trucker with a monster truck. Nobody involved was trying to make art, which is why every one of them is a good time.

films.note: Sho Kosugi, Salt Lake City, and a rooftop fight that the whole decade of ninja films was chasing.
A ninja's ghost possesses an aerobics instructor. Cannon Films, 1984. That sentence is the whole review.
Franco Nero in a white ninja suit. The one that started the craze.
Fred Williamson does Cobra, in Italy, for less. Better sunglasses.
James Brolin, Anthony Quinn and James Coburn rob a Colombian drug lord. Cheap, fast and not stupid.
A trucker builds a monster truck to avenge his family. Ned Beatty as the villain. It delivers exactly what the poster says.
Women-in-prison meets mad science. Ray Sharkey and Marjoe Gortner, both unhinged.
Joe Don Baker as a Texas sheriff loose in Malta. Beloved by Mystery Science Theater for good reason.
Michael Mann's first Hannibal Lecter film, three years before Silence of the Lambs. William Petersen as the profiler who thinks like the killer.
